adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. Because `&&` short-circuits, if `isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)` returns falsy (likely for `teamId ?? 0` on non-team bookings), the `isTeamOwner(...)` call will not execute. So the diff does not show “both queries run” and therefore does not verify “two pointless DB round-trips” (at most one would run).
